item.title: Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty in federal case in UnitedHealthcare killing, AP source says
item.description: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty as early as Friday in the federal case accusing him of stalking and killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, a stunning development in a case that rattled business leaders while galvanizing their critics, according to a person familiar with the matter.
